# SCI-FRUIT scientific core: sanitized prior-work recovery

## Program adherence and prior-work recovery

This record follows the [program charter and accepted roadmap](PROGRAM_AND_AUTHOR_TASK_R0.1.md).
It is the author-facing part of completed Stage A recovery. The manager's
complete recovery dossier stays outside this packet. The exact read set and
source identities are in the [input manifest](INPUT_MANIFEST_R0.1.md).

The source authorities retain their own scientific content. The permitted
extracts do not import numerical routes, authorize unrestricted source access
or turn a conditional mathematical description into available measurements.
Mixed historical scope, implementation and validation material is excluded.

## What is already answered

FRUIT does not own the PTC estimator, MAP/JINC estimator, coordinate truth or
NOI ensemble method. Fixed-state application and full relearning have different
response and uncertainty meanings. Producer validity is distinct from fitness
for a feedback model or a downstream use. Scientific authority is distinct
from implementation conformity, empirical performance and qualification.
Reuse these distinctions; do not derive a replacement ownership framework.

## Genuinely new work

The scientific gap is the conditional closure of the feedback procedure:
the relation between target and selected model; exact model removal, bypass
and restoration; conditional response and lost information; sufficient causal
state; and termination and terminal-product meaning. The Scope Brief bounds
the mathematical questions and predictive cases. No particular recurrence,
cleaning policy, projector or stopping threshold has been selected.

The manager found no additional core-level owner choice needed to attempt
this bounded derivation. That judgment does not guarantee closure. A missing
premise needed only by a numerical profile stays explicit; a premise necessary
for the core itself must be returned as a precise owner question.
